label: An ungodly covenant with Turkey and Syria to pray against
description: Given ahead of a presidential visit to Turkey: ungodly alliances and covenants being made with Turkey and Syria that will be seen in agreements in the days ahead, framed as a snare set for the president rather than a partnership.
aliases: There'll be ungodly alliances to pray against
Turkey, Syria trying to snare him

label: An antichrist spirit works on the president's mind
description: A demonic and antichrist influencing spirit seen trying to work on the president's mind, particularly on foreign ground, with the danger stated as being deceived rather than physically harmed, and said to succeed only without a prayer covering.
aliases: an antichrist spirit trying to influence President Trump's mind
This is a demonic spirit trying to mess with him
It's not just physical protection, but being deceived

label: The president is exposed on Turkish ground
description: A hedge of protection called for a presidential visit to Turkey, given against footage of a mass funeral where things were thrown at the president in effigy, with the point that he will be on their turf.
aliases: He's going to be in Turkey on their turf
we must pray a hedge of protection on this

label: Weather control is lost and straight line winds pass 150 mph
description: That as they try to control the weather they will lose control, with straight line winds over one hundred and fifty miles an hour, comparable to a category four hurricane. He says he sees in part and does not know when.
aliases: as they try to control the weather they will lose control
The Lord said they will lose control

label: A humbling and a second wind on America's 250th
description: Given on 4 July 2026: a prayer that the president be given a second wind on the nation's two hundred and fiftieth anniversary, with a humbling he says he can feel coming, and the church rising and shining in the middle of it.
aliases: on this 250th anniversary of our beautiful nation
there is a humbling. I feel it
